Curate only after an SI-native or fully documented coefficient table is inspected; do not relabel mass-basis ADxEF as new coverage.

gaps: New quantity meanings: fuel purchased/stock/burned masses, feedstock-excluded combustion fuel, total/listed/accountable CO2 masses. Ledger mass units kg/t are shared with prior batches; no runtime projection is claimed.

Duplicate search limited to the supplied catalog snapshot and batches b01-b05; these ledger-adjustment identities do not duplicate emission-factor, intensity, diversion, family-sum or per-capita records.
handoff.review_notes: Checks performed: curation validate (schema/grammar/arithmetic/guards); 6 references; 3 domain rejections; inverse substitutions; prose-vs-locator fidelity; canonical-units review (common ledger unit, no inlined x100/x1000, no external Btu-J conversion). Not performed: central scientific review, lab replication, legal clearance beyond recorded terms.
handoff.summary: Batch b05 (3 models): (14) fuel burned from purchases plus stock change, (15) feedstock-excluded fuel for combustion analysis, and (16) accountable fossil CO2 excluding listed biomass-CO2 memo. All are same-unit ledger identities from EPA Climate Leaders stationary-combustion guidance; the full Equation 1 product is deferred pending SI-native calibration.

assumptions: Source assumption: purchased, stock and burned quantities are the same fuel, site, reporting period and mass basis; purchase records proxy combustion only after stock/feedstock adjustments (EPA Section 5.1, Equation 3).
Application profile: mass-metered fuels; volume-metered fuels need a separate unit-consistent application with the same equation shape.

gaps: Requires new quantity meanings for purchased, stock and burned fuel masses; ledger mass unit t is shared. Scalar form fits the engine once meanings exist.

models.inverse_notes: FuelB with FuelP and FuelST determines FuelSE = FuelP + FuelST - FuelB; FuelB with FuelP and FuelSE determines FuelST = FuelB - FuelP + FuelSE; FuelB with stocks determines FuelP = FuelB - FuelST + FuelSE. Original nonnegativity and stock-consistency guards apply. Substitution checks: 1000 + 200 - 150 = 1050 recovers case ordinary-stock-draw; 1050 - 1000 + 150 = 200 recovers FuelST. Algebraic only; negative FuelB would indicate a data/boundary error, not combustion.
limitations: Feedstock/non-combustion use is handled by a separate exclusion; do not subtract feedstock inside this stock equation unless the purchased quantity is already combustion-only.
Fugitive/non-combustion releases and storage losses outside the stock endpoints need separate source treatment.

references.method: Independent arithmetic in EPA Equation 3 form: 1000 purchased plus opening 200 minus closing 150.
references.provenance: Independent arithmetic reasoning from stated inputs; not a published facility total.

references.method: Boundary identity: equal opening and closing stocks leave burned fuel equal to purchases.
references.provenance: Definitional boundary check; not an empirical validation.

rejection_cases.reason: Closing stock exceeds purchases plus opening stock, implying negative burned fuel; the stock-consistency guard rejects it as a data/boundary error.

relationship.locator: Section 5.1 'Activity Data Source' (Equation 3: Fuel B = Fuel P + (Fuel ST - Fuel SE))
relationship.original_equation: Fuel burned in reporting period = fuel purchased + opening stock - closing stock (FuelB = FuelP + FuelST - FuelSE)
relationship.translation_notes: Purchase-to-burn ledger adjustment: all quantities in a common fuel mass unit (t), output in t. Dimensional check: mass = mass + mass - mass. Parentheses expanded without changing the accounting identity; no conversion inlined.

sources.evidence: Paraphrase: fuel burned can be estimated from fuel purchases adjusted for stock change as Fuel B = Fuel P + (Fuel ST - Fuel SE); purchase data must also be adjusted for inventory changes, fugitive/spill losses and feedstock use.

assumptions: Source assumption: purchased and feedstock quantities are the same fuel, site, reporting period and mass basis; carbon leaving in products is stored, not combusted, and is excluded from direct combustion analysis (EPA Section 5.1).
Application profile: isolate the feedstock exclusion; stock adjustments belong to the separate inventory-adjustment record and must use the same purchased quantity without double counting.

gaps: Requires new quantity meanings for purchased, feedstock and combustion-analysis fuel masses; ledger mass unit t is shared. Scalar form fits the engine once meanings exist.

models.inverse_notes: FuelC with FuelP determines FuelF = FuelP - FuelC; FuelC with FuelF determines FuelP = FuelC + FuelF. Original guards apply. Substitution checks: 1000 - 850 = 150 recovers case ordinary-feedstock-use; 850 + 150 = 1000 recovers FuelP. Algebraic only; stored carbon may later be released outside this facility boundary.
limitations: Covers only non-combustion feedstock/product storage at the reporting facility; subsequent combustion elsewhere is outside this record.
Waste-fuel fossil/biomass splits use stream-specific carbon accounting, not this purchased-minus-feedstock form alone.

references.method: Independent arithmetic in EPA feedstock-adjustment form: 1000 purchased minus 150 stored in products.
references.provenance: Independent arithmetic reasoning from stated inputs; not a published facility total.

references.method: Boundary identity: zero feedstock leaves the combustion-analysis quantity equal to purchases.
references.provenance: Definitional boundary check; not an empirical validation.

rejection_cases.reason: Feedstock use cannot exceed purchased fuel under the same boundary; the FuelP >= FuelF guard rejects it.

relationship.locator: Section 5.1 'Activity Data Source' (subtract feedstock fuel stored in products from purchased fuel before calculating emissions)
relationship.original_equation: Combustion-analysis fuel quantity = purchased fuel - fuel used as feedstock (FuelC = FuelP - FuelF)
relationship.translation_notes: Feedstock exclusion on a common fuel mass unit (t): mass = mass - mass. This is a ledger-scope adjustment, not an emission-factor estimate; no conversion inlined.

sources.evidence: Paraphrase: purchased fuels used as feedstock store carbon in products, so subtract feedstock fuel from purchased fuel before calculating combustion emissions; carbon leaving stored in a product is not counted as a facility release.

assumptions: Source assumption: total and memo quantities are the same facility, reporting period, fuel scope and CO2 mass basis; biomass CO2 is listed but excluded from the Climate Leaders CO2e reduction inventory (EPA Sections 1.2-1.3).
Application profile: fossil-waste combustion is included while non-fossil waste CO2 is listed as biomass memo; offsets from waste-fuel use are reported separately, not netted here.

gaps: Requires new quantity meanings for analyzed total, listed biomass memo and accountable fossil CO2; mass unit kg is shared. Scalar form fits the engine once meanings exist.

models.inverse_notes: Cacct with Ctotal determines Bmemo = Ctotal - Cacct; Cacct with Bmemo determines Ctotal = Cacct + Bmemo. Original guards apply. Substitution checks: 500 - 460 = 40 recovers case ordinary-biomass-share; 460 + 40 = 500 recovers Ctotal. Algebraic only; memo listing remains required and land-use carbon-stock assumptions stay outside the expression.
limitations: The exclusion assumes no net biomass-carbon stock loss from land-use practices; that assumption needs its own land-use evidence.
CH4/N2O from biomass combustion follow separate scope treatment and are not removed by this CO2 memo rule.
Waste-fuel offsets, if any, are reported separately and must not be netted through this memo exclusion.

references.method: Independent arithmetic in EPA biomass-memo form: 500 analyzed minus 40 listed biomass CO2.
references.provenance: Independent arithmetic reasoning from stated inputs; not a published facility total.

references.method: Boundary identity: zero biomass memo leaves accountable CO2 equal to the analyzed total.
references.provenance: Definitional boundary check; not an empirical validation.

rejection_cases.reason: Listed biomass CO2 cannot exceed the analyzed combustion CO2 under the same scope; the Ctotal >= Bmemo guard rejects it.

relationship.locator: Sections 1.2 'Biofuels' and 1.3 'Waste Fuels' (biomass CO2 listed separately and excluded from the tracked CO2e inventory; fossil waste-fuel CO2 included)
relationship.original_equation: Accountable fossil CO2 = analyzed combustion CO2 - listed biomass CO2 memo (Cacct = Ctotal - Bmemo)
relationship.translation_notes: Memo-line boundary adjustment on a common CO2 mass unit (kg): mass = mass - mass. This implements the reporting scope, not atmospheric fate; no offset netting is included.

sources.evidence: Paraphrase: biomass CO2 is listed as total gas emitted but excluded from the overall CO2e inventory used to track progress, assuming no net biomass-carbon loss from land use; fossil-portion waste-fuel CO2 is included while non-fossil waste CO2 is listed as biomass.
